description: ByteAsk Context: one turn-0 pack attempt for a user message (sent only in sessions with ByteAsk Context configured).

attempted.description: The harness called `find_code_for_task` for this message.

autoIndex.description: Pre-approved indexing of an unindexed repository: `started` or `failed`.

injected.description: The answer went into the user turn before the first model request.

message.description: The one line for the user, if any.

reason.description: Why nothing was injected (`not_a_task`, `not_cpp_repo`, `not_git_repo`, `not_indexed`, `indexing`, `timeout`, `error`); null when injected.

testPrograms.description: The test programs the answer names as exercising its top places.

warmBuildStarted.description: A background build of those test programs was started.
